::: {.function-badge}
[Projection Abroad](../function/projection-abroad.qmd)
:::

Supporting autocratic leaders involves providing political, economic, or informational resources to maintain or strengthen authoritarian regimes. This mechanism may include diplomatic backing, financial aid, media support, or security assistance, with the aim of preserving friendly governments or expanding influence.
